exposure: Time interval between first dose of corticosteroids and delivery (<2 days, 2-7 days, >7 days)
time interval between ACS administration and delivery
Time interval between ACS administration and delivery
cohort: Late preterm (34+0 to 36+6 weeks) neonates born to mothers with diabetes
finding: Antenatal corticosteroid treatment was not associated with neonatal hypoglycemia or respiratory outcomes in late preterm neonates born to diabetic mothers, regardless of the time interval to delivery.
